scope: Three main source panels and three enlarged arc diagnostics actually opened and inspected. Main panels compare preserved working master (EP: preserved reconstruction, not KML), current source and candidate at same extent, EPSG:3035, 1:10M and96dpi. The red arcs were independently verified to consist only of archived NE reference edges; blue is candidate. Enlarged panels are diagnostics, not accuracy measurement.

AH: Recognizable imperial outline and historical mainland boundaries remain unchanged; selected Adriatic coast follows same broad route.
Current donor bays/peninsulas are denser than the old NE proxy but remain legible at1:10M. Adopted islands remain separate and unchanged.
DEU: Overall representative imperial outline and all nonselected coastal/land routes remain unchanged.
Two Baltic sections include different current donor coastal detail; these are display-proxy differences, not newly verified historical shoreline or reclaimed-land events.
Shared Sambian section is the same as East Prussia, including the two computed intersections and retained original endpoints.
EP: Preserved canonical reconstruction and candidate retain the same recognizable province outline, lagoon closure, northern partition and eastern route.
Sambian coast change is bounded by actual intersections; no independent reconstruction of the original LKI KML was performed.

notClaimed: No historical positional accuracy or original EP KML recovery.
No uniform scale-derived distance tolerance, simplification or smoothing.
